name: Shandong Lukang Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shandong Lukang Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd. operates as a pharmaceutical company in China. The company offers systemic anti-infectives, hypoglycemic agents, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular drugs, respiratory medicines, neurodegenerative disease treatments, digestive and metabolic disease drugs, antitumor drugs, and traditional Chinese and Tibetan medicines. The company also provides synthetic biology products, including trans-aconitic acid, perillyl alcohol, bisabolol, and patchouli alcohol, and engages in the production and sale of feed additives and import-export trade; and ceftriaxone sodium, acetylspiramycin, amoxicillin, tadalafil tablets, acarbose, rosuvastatin, isosorbide mononitrate s…
